top.title: Yankees Reveal Whether Giancarlo Stanton Will Be Back With Team
top.description: New York Yankees designated hitter Giancarlo Stanton Giancarlo Stanton missed most of the New York Yankees' season this year, and there was speculation that the team could finally move on from him this winter. When healthy, Stanton is an impact bat with tons of power. However, he has not been healthy too often. He is 37 years old, and the Yankees owe him $15 million for next season. He has a $15 million club option with a $10 million buyout for 2028. Despite rumors of the Yankees potentially moving on, general manager Brian Cashman made it clear that Stanton is not going anywhere. "There's never been a time when he's healthy that he's not been impactful," Cashman said on Tuesday . "If he's healthy, I know he can impact. I know he can get streaky and all that stuff, but he's an impact hitter, and always has been. Hopefully we'll get a healthy Stanton. He's a big presence in our clubhouse, a great leader. He's wired right. He's doing everything he possibly can to impact us in a real positive way. He's not going anywhere. He'll be in spring training with us, without a doubt." Stanton is 44 home runs shy of 500 and has a strong case for the Hall of Fame when he retires. He is strictly going to be a designated hitter, which means the Yankees will have to keep Aaron Judge in the outfield. Judge is a capable defender, but as he gets older, keeping him off his feet should become a priority. The Yankees saw what can happen to their offense when he's hurt, and moving him to a full-time designated hitter role soon should be considered. The Yankees cannot do that with Stanton on the team, so it looks like Judge will be in right field again next year. More MLB: Reds Slugger Wins 2026 NL Rookie Of The Year

top.title: Oregon star edge rusher Teitum Tuioti out for the season
top.description: EUGENE — One of Oregon football’s most important defensive players is done for the season. Ducks senior defensive end Teitum Tuioti suffered a season-ending knee injury in Oregon’s 41-28 win over Ohio State , Dan Lanning announced on Monday. “Teitum has been unbelievable for us this year, and every year he’s been here,” Lanning said. “Just watching him grow as a player and person has been a lot of fun for us. But unfortunately Teitum’s done for the year, he had a knee injury, he’ll end up having surgery.” Tuioti was among the Ducks’ leaders in tackles with 44, and ranked second on the team in sacks with 5.5 on the season. The former Sheldon High School star sits at No. 8 all-time for Oregon with 22.5 sacks across his four seasons, providing steady leadership on a talented and experienced defensive front. In the win over the Buckeyes, he also showed off his arm: Tuioti completed a pass to fellow defensive end Matayo Uiagalelei on a memorable fake punt which shifted momentum in the game. “I hate it for him, because (the injury) was a routine, weird play that it happened on,” Lanning said. “He left it on the line there on the field, and I don’t know if he’ll get another chance to play as an Oregon football player, but whoever gets to have that guy on their team in the future is gonna be really, really lucky.” Should Tuioti forgo his fifth year of eligibility and enter the NFL Draft, he is a projected second- or third-round pick according to some mock drafts. top.title: Damian Lillard is back and Ja Morant is here. How exactly is this going to work? | Bill Oram
top.description: In the history of basketball, we have certainly seen some why-would-they-do-that? pairings. Jerseys and sleeves. Kawhi Leonard and a tree sponsorship. Utah and “the Jazz.” Once, there was even Detlef Schrempf and a headband, if you can believe that. Ja Morant and Damian Lillard? We’re about to find out if they belong on such a list. Because of all the things you might have said the Trail Blazers needed as they prepared to welcome Lillard back after making a playoff run without him, a slight-of-stature ball-dominant guard with a questionable jump shot would not have topped anyone’s list. Depth on the wing? Yes. Shooting? Definitely. Defense? Always. Morant doesn’t particularly address any of those, and yet, he’s here, a dynamic two-time All-Star in need of a second act, being paid a team-high $42.1 million to play the same position as not just Lillard, but Jrue Holiday and Scoot Henderson. Heck, the Blazers’ most valuable point guard last season was forward Deni Avdija. “I’m sure there will be questions about fit,” General Manager Joe Cronin said Monday. Uh, yeah. The Blazers have little more than three weeks before the regular season begins in which to figure that out. At the team’s annual media day on Monday, Morant appeared in a fresh white No. 1 Trail Blazers jersey. It’s happening. “It’s easy for people to be like, ‘Man how is this going to work,’” Lillard offered. “‘They can’t do this, they can’t do that.’ But being on the floor with them … we can be a dangerous team and I really believe that.” The onus is on the Trail Blazers starting this month to prove that they bet right in acquiring Morant. And that pairing him with Lillard isn’t the boondoggle conventional wisdom suggests it will be. Lillard noted how many teams that succeeded in the playoffs last year, think San Antonio with its four point guards, relied on numerous playmakers. To his credit, Morant said he would be comfortable coming off the bench, if necessary. But they would not be the first NBA team to fall into the trap of believing they are capable of adjusting or that they will be comfortable sacrificing. It isn’t uncommon to see players in those situations default to familiar habits and sensibilities once the season is underway or struggles come. That’s what made a lot of the positive energy around what sure seems like an awkward roster ring so hollow. We’re going to need to see it to believe it. top.title: Who will call plays for Oregon after Mehringer's firing?
top.description: EUGENE — After firing first-year offensive coordinator Drew Mehringer seven games into the 2026 season, Dan Lanning shared Oregon ’s plans for filling his role moving forward at his weekly press conference Monday night. Offensive assistant Jay Johnson will lead offensive playcalling for the Ducks going forward, Lanning said. “He has a lot of experience as a play-caller, was with me in Georgia when we were part of the national championship team,” Lanning said. “Went on to have a lot of success in Colorado and Michigan State. He’s gonna lead the efforts there with the offensive staff, but it’ll still be a collaborative effort, with a lot of the work that we do. “He’s also coming in with a different perspective, a different view, not being with us the last few years, where he can provide a couple things that might be different than what we’ve done.” Mehringer, previously the tight ends coach for the Ducks, is the first assistant coach Lanning has fired in his tenure at Oregon, which began in 2022. The Ducks’ offensive decision-making was at the center of intense criticism over the past three weeks, during which Oregon averaged just 14 points per game and lost twice to UCLA and Illinois. Lanning spoke to the human element of letting Mehringer go. “They see the football coach, right? That’s also an unbelievable dad. A great husband,” Lanning said. “The guy’s been part of our staff for the last five years, that’s done some really good things here, and I think all of us feel like we shoulder some of the blame. top.title: Lanning: Stewart incident 'didn't match our standard'
top.description: EUGENE — After Oregon wide receiver Evan Stewart was booked in Springfield Municipal Jail early Sunday morning on DUII charges, Ducks coach Dan Lanning addressed the situation at his weekly press conference Monday. “There was an incident this weekend that didn’t match our standard here in our program,” Lanning said. “There will be an appropriate action taken. Still gathering some details with what that situation looks like. But that would be handled internally. I’m not gonna respond to any other questions about that. We’re gonna handle that with our guys. “There’s an expectation of what you have to... how you have to act, and how you need to perform in our program. Kind of overshadows the success that we had on Saturday, which is disappointing, but that will be handled by us internally. I’m not going to speak on it publicly.” When Lanning was asked a follow-up question about a rumored speeding incident involving other Oregon football players, for which there haven’t been any confirmed arrests, he said, “I was talking about the same thing when I first addressed it.” This is also the second instance of an Oregon football team member facing DUII charges in the past year. In April, running backs coach Ra’Shaad Samples allegedly backed his Ford F-150 into a parked car outside a bar in Eugene. His next court date is Oct. 27. An arraignment for Stewart in his DUII case hasn’t been set, as official charges haven’t been filed to Springfield Municipal Court as of Monday evening, according to court records. Stewart leads the Ducks this season with 27 catches for 352 yards and four touchdowns. He missed Saturday’s win over Nebraska due to an undisclosed injury. Oregon (4-2, 2-1 Big Ten) is preparing for a road game at Illinois (3-3, 1-2) at 12 p.m. PT this coming Saturday. top.title: Injured Feyi-Waboso is our Robinson – Sinfield
top.description: Feyi-Waboso had a superb second-minute score ruled out for a forward pass in a previous phase during Sunday's win over Australia [Getty Images] Immanuel Feyi-Waboso, England's prolific but injury-prone wing, is the 2026 team's equivalent of Rugby World Cup winner Jason Robinson says assistant coach Kevin Sinfield. Feyi-Waboso has scored nine tries in 17 appearances for England since making his Test debut against Italy in 2024. However, his progress with England has been checked by a string of injuries. He missed the 2025 Six Nations with a shoulder injury, while his 2026 tournament was ended by a hamstring injury sustained in training before England's opening-round win over Wales. He returned this summer, scoring in wins over Fiji and Argentina, but suffered an autumn-ending ankle injury in the first half of Sunday's match against Australia. Robinson, whose acceleration and side-step brought him 28 tries in 51 appearances for England between 2001 and 2007, tore his hamstring in the Rugby World Cup final defeat by South Africa in his final Test. "He is our Jason Robinson," said Sinfield, who played against Robinson during the pair's days in rugby league. "When you have a player who is that explosive and that powerful sometimes a run of injuries just happens. "He's across everything to do with his body and hopefully we get him back firing as soon as we can. "That collaboration [between England and Feyi-Waboso's club Exeter] is going be really important because these guys play a lot of rugby. "Making sure they're fit for those big games is going to be really important." England have the final say over the fitness and conditioning of centrally-contracted players such as Feyi-Waboso, but there have been disagreements in the past with Exeter over his treatment. Relations have since improved with England signing off Fey-Waboso's return for June's Prem final, only three weeks after he suffered a facial fracture. Feyi-Waboso played on after suffering his ankle injury in the 32nd minute of Sunday's 45-22 win over the Wallabies, hobbling his way to half-time before being replaced. Sinfield said that the desire of Feyi-Waboso, who is studying medicine, to stay on the pitch swayed the decision to keep him on. "It's getting the balance right, because the player is telling you he wants to try and run it off," said Sinfield. "You can't scan anyone on the grass, so you're looking at it with your eyes. I think it's only right for us, as coaches, that we listen to players." England will be without Ollie Chessum, George Furbank and Seb Atkinson for Saturday's match against Japan, while flanker Tom Curry has, like Feyi-Waboso, been ruled out of the entire autumn campaign after he aggravated a long-standing hip issue. top.title: CB Dylan Haley decommits from Tennessee
top.description: Flowery Branch (Ga.) Cherokee Bluff cornerback Dylan Haley , a three-star prospect in the 2027 class, decommitted from Tennessee on Tuesday. He had been committed to the Volunteers since June. Haley originally picked Tennessee over offers from Ole Miss , Georgia Tech , Georgia and Auburn , among others. “After much prayer, thought, and conversations with my family, I have decided to decommit from the University of Tennessee and reopen my recruitment,” Haley posted on social media. “I am grateful for the relationships I’ve built and the opportunities I’ve been given.” The Rivals Industry Rankings , a weighted average that utilizes all three major recruiting services, ranks Haley as the No. 552 prospect in the 2027 class and the No. 57 cornerback nationally. He’s listed at 6-foot-1 and 180 pounds. Tennessee’s 2027 class Tennessee sits at No. 22 nationally and 10th in the SEC in the Rivals Industry Team Rankings . Haley’s exit leaves Josh Heupel ‘s program with 18 commitments in the 2027 class. Five-star running back David Gabriel Georges (No. 8) is the top-ranked pledge in the Vols’ class. Wide receiver Kesean Bowman (No. 69) and linebacker Kenneth Simon II (No. 156) are among the six four-stars pledged to Heupel’s program. Tennessee still has three cornerbacks committed: three-stars Slim Leavell (No. 659), Preston Glasco (No. 720) and Carter Jamison (No. 1,164). Glasco committed Oct. 28.

top.title: Kirk Cousins has 3-word message for Fernando Mendoza after Raiders trade
top.description: Fernandomania has officially begun in the desert. With the Las Vegas Raiders trading quarterback Kirk Cousins to the Minnesota Vikings in before Tuesday’s NFL trade deadline, Las Vegas are expected to turn to Fernando Mendoza , the No. 1 pick in the draft earlier this year, under center. Mendoza is slated to make his first career start against the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks at home on Sunday, Nov. 15 (4:05 ET). Mendoza’s lone regular-season action came during his debut, at the end of a Week 4 road loss to the New England Patriots on Oct. 11. He finished 6-for-8 passing for 48 yards. Mendoza’s first two opponents boast vaunted defensive units. Seattle’s defense, dubbed the “Dark Side” for a reason, did not allow a touchdown last week to the undermanned Arizona Cardinals. Looking ahead, the Raiders face the Denver Broncos on the road in Week 11. Denver ranks in the top 10 in points allowed per game (20.7), sacks (26) and takeaways (12). "I feel that Fernando has done a great job,” Cousins told reporters Oct. 26. “He has a bright future ahead. I'm going to try and go out there and play as well as I possibly can and try and win and give him a good example to learn from." On his Instagram story, Cousins offered a goodbye to “Raider Nation” and a message to Mendoza, whom Cousins tagged in the post. “Go get em (sic),” Cousins wrote. Toughening matters for Mendoza on the field will be the lack of a rushing attack for the Raiders. First-round talent Ashton Jeanty from the 2025 draft has not worked out, although rookie Mike Washington has shown some juice in the backfield. Still, Las Vegas ranks 31st in rushing yards per game (71.3) and is last in yards per rush (2.9). Similar to Cousins, Mendoza will likely have to shoulder much of the output in the Raiders’ offense. “The game has to be balanced,” head coach Klint Kubiak said following the team’s most recent loss to the San Francisco 49ers that dropped their record to 4-5. “You can’t be a running and throwing team when you're throwing it every time. That's not easy. “You got to start the game a lot faster. You got to go toe-to-toe in the first half so that the second half isn't a throwing fest.” The good news is that tight end Brock Bowers ranks ninth in the league in receiving yards and provides a crucial red-zone target with six touchdowns already this season. Wide receiver Tre Tucker emerged as a reliable downfield option for Cousins, which gives Mendoza more relief in the passing game. top.description: Domeiro Bobb-Semple (right) scored a goal in each half for the Bees youngsters [Getty Images] Brentford U21 and League One side Leicester City both moved into the knockout stages of the Jersey Mike's Trophy with vital victories. The Bees had to beat the Football League's basement side Crawley Town in their final fixture in Southern Group H to progress and did so courtesy of a Domeiro Bobb-Semple double in a 2-1 success at Broadfield Stadium, where Connor Wickham scored on his Crawley debut. In Southern Group B, the Foxes trailed at the King Power Stadium against League Two Walsall, who would have gone through in place of their hosts with a win. But strikes from Will Smallbone and John Lundstram put them ahead by the break and they held on. Stevenage topped the group by beating Fulham U21 on penalties. Chelsea U21 were not in action but went through at the expense of Reading , who needed a big win away against Bristol Rovers to see them overtake the west London side in Southern Group C, but the Royals were beaten on penalties. Nottingham Forest U21 and Notts County both eased through into the last 16 with wins in Northern Group F. Forest enjoyed a 3-0 success against League Two promotion-chasers Grimsby Town at Blundell Park, where all the goals came before the break. The Magpies moved into the knockout stages as group winners by beating League One Burton Albion by the same scoreline for a third win in three EFL Trophy games. In Southern Group F, Leyton Orient needed a big victory over Barnet to claim an unlikely second-placed finish on goal difference, but they were well beaten at The Hive, with Jack Maskell's first-half strike setting the hosts on the way to a 4-2 win. top.title: AFC Team Shows Interest in Ex-Steelers Kicker
top.description: Pittsburgh Steelers kicker Ben Sauls in a preseason game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Aug. 16, 2025. -- Ed Thompson / Steelers Now A former kicker of the Pittsburgh Steelers could soon have a new home in the NFL. The Miami Dolphins worked out former Pittsburgh Steelers kicker Ben Sauls on Tuesday, according to NFL insider Aaron Wilson of Houston’s KPRC2 . #Dolphins worked out Marcus Banks, Daniel Carlson, Cameron Dorner, Kahlef Hailassie, Chris Hilton, Austin Reed, Ben Sauls, Christopher Smith, Bailey Zappe — Aaron Wilson (@AaronWilson_NFL) November 10, 2026 Sauls, 25, was just released by the New York Giants in September and has been looking for his next opportunity since. Sauls played his collegiate career at the University of Pittsburgh and signed with the Steelers as an undrafted free agent out of the 2025 NFL Draft. He impressed during the preseason, making five of his six field goal attempts and going seven of seven on extra points. “Really happy for Ben Sauls. The work he was able to show us,” head coach Mike Tomlin said. “Good for him.” Pittsburgh Steelers kicker Ben Sauls during a preseason game against the Carolina Panthers on Aug. 21, 2025. — Ed Thompson / Steelers Now However, Sauls’ future in Pittsburgh was always uncertain since the team already had two-time Pro Bowl kicker Chris Boswell on the roster. The Steelers did try to trade Sauls following his standout preseason performance, but they were unable to find a trade partner and waived him ahead of the cutdown day deadline. On Sept. 23, 2025, the Atlanta Falcons signed Sauls to their practice squad. He was then released on Nov. 4 and the Giants signed him one week later. Sauls’ time with the Steelers was brief, but he was still very appreciative of Pittsburgh’s veterans for showing him the ropes at the next level. “To have guys who have been there and done that for years. I mean, the age gap. I think the second youngest is 30, maybe 31. I just turned 24 a couple of weeks ago. I am a breath of fresh air for these guys. But they’ve been there, they’ve done that,” Sauls said. “They reassure me on the field. And to have them with me this whole way. That’s why we just got a silly picture of us. Because I really appreciate what they’ve done for me. And they really took me in and showed me the ropes.” In 2024, Sauls connected on 21 of 24 field goals and a perfect 44 of 44 on extra points at Pitt. He was selected to the Pro Football Focus All-American team and a Lou Groza Collegiate Place-Kicker Award Semifinalist. Overall, Sauls finished his college career hitting on 52 of 64 field-goal attempts, while averaging 63 yards per kickoff. top.title: Dan Le Batard admits he deserves to be called a snitch after uncovering ‘White House’ story
top.description: Credit: The Dan Le Batard Show, FS1 If anyone wants to accuse Dan Le Batard of snitching on the 1990s Dallas Cowboys for their “White House,” he’s not going to argue it. Former NFL wide receiver and current football analyst Andrew Hawkins was on The Dan Le Batard Show Tuesday morning. Hawkins also regularly contributes to Michael Irvin’s sports podcast for Netflix, The White House , prompting Le Batard to express surprise about the show title. ﻿ “Michael Irvin, I am shocked that he has named his show The White House ,” Le Batard said .”For those of you who don’t know some of this backstory, many years ago, when the Super Bowl was in Miami, I, showing no judgement at all that was good as news judgement, put in the 30th paragraph of a story that the Cowboys had a white house in Dallas that they called the White House to have parties with people who were not their wives.” The White House was known as the NFL’s biggest party house in the ’90s. Some have compared it to a brothel, Irvin has described it as a “safe place for camaraderie.” Details on the house began to leak in 1996 after Irvin was involved in a hotel-room drug and prostitution arrest. But according to Le Batard, he put the Cowboys White House in the 30th paragraph of a story about sex and the Super Bowl decades ago. The admission by Le Batard garnered unison chants of “snitch” from the rest of the show. An accusation Le Batard didn’t even bother to deny. “It’s fair,” Le Batard admitted. “It’s actually fair commentary. But I put it in the 30th paragraph, I just tossed it in at the end.” “No one has ever called me a snitch before on that. And I deserve it. I absolutely deserve it,” Le Batard added. “Pablo Torre is getting some snitch stuff, but that’s not snitch stuff. What we just did there is snitch stuff. But it was the 30th paragraph.” Le Batard may have been one of the first to reference the infamous Cowboys White House in mainstream media, but it was only a matter of time before someone blew the roof off that safe place for camaraderie to expose it. top.title: Scott Brown reveals hilarious disguise he wore to avoid Celtic fans at the darts
top.description: Scott Brown reveals hilarious disguise he wore to avoid Celtic fans at the darts Celtic legend Scott Brown has revealed he once attended the darts dressed as a Minion to avoid being recognised by supporters. The former Hoops captain made the hilarious admission ahead of taking on former European champion Ross Smith at a darts exhibition event in Edinburgh. Brown, who enjoyed a trophy-laden career at Celtic Park, swapped his football boots for darts and even sported a specially-made shirt featuring his iconic No.8. The former Scotland international was handed a significant advantage, starting on 501 while Smith began on 1001, but was ultimately unable to cause an upset. Speaking ahead of the event, Brown revealed he had previously gone to extraordinary lengths to enjoy the darts without attracting attention. He said: “I have been to the darts before dressed up as a Minion; nobody ever knew I was there! “I really do enjoy the darts. My wee brother is coming along as well, and he enjoys the darts so he’ll be buzzing that I get beat on stage. Playing in front of 60 or 70,000 is OK when I know I can control the ball and pass it, make a tackle and stuff. “I can’t really judge my darts quality, shall I say. Standing in front of 1,000 people, if I miss the board they’ll be delighted. If I hit the board I will be delighted.” The former Celtic skipper, who is friends with World Cup winner John Henderson, acknowledged the dedication required to compete at the highest level. He added: “See, when they stand up there with nerves in front of people, I understand the pressure they are under and how well they play. The experience and practice they put in, as well as standing in front of a dartboard, some people might see it as draining. But some really, really enjoy that. “The ones that stand there and practice are the reason they are world champions, and they are up there in the top 10.” Despite his enthusiasm for darts, Brown insisted he would not swap his glittering collection of Celtic honours for success on the oche. top.title: Ernesto Valverde’s name under consideration at Man United as Ineos scramble
top.description: Ernesto Valverde’s name under consideration at Man United as Ineos scramble Michael Carrick is expected to be sacked as Manchester United head coach, but INEOS have yet to formally decide when they will break the news to the club legend. Omar Berrada and Jason Wilcox are scheduled to meet Sir Jim Ratcliffe in Monaco tomorrow, having already decided to make a change at the helm. However, in the absence of Ratcliffe’s approval, Carrick has been left in limbo. It is believed he is set to take training again tomorrow after spending time at Carrington on Tuesday. The same level of uncertainty is apparent in their search for the next man in charge. Manchester United now considering Ernesto Valverde Earlier today, The Peoples Person relayed a report claiming the Glazer family favour Mauricio Pochettino while Jason Wilcox, the club’s director of football, would prefer to bring Eddie Howe to Old Trafford. Now, according to Football FanCast , former Barcelona and Athletic Club manager Ernesto Valverde is another name under consideration at United as the club weigh up their options. The Spanish tactician is currently available after departing Athletic Club earlier this year. He left the Bilbao-based outfit in May after achieving the remarkable milestone of managing the Basque side for 500 games across three different spells. The 62-year-old is known for building defensively resilient sides who rely on quick transitions to cut open opponents. Valverde won back-to-back La Liga titles in 2018 and 2019 as Barcelona’s manager. Who would be the ideal Michael Carrick replacement? However, Valverde is unlikely to be seriously considered for the role due to his lack of Premier League experience. This is why the likes of Pochettino and Howe have been strongly linked with the United job, but neither offers a proven track record of winning the biggest trophies. nigeria.title: Tinubu Won 2023 Election On His Own, Buhari Didn’t Fully Support Him – APC’s Hassan
nigeria.description: A spokesperson for the All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council, Alwan Hassan, has said President Bola Tinubu won the 2023 presidential election against all odds, insisting that former President Muhammadu Buhari did not fully support his candidacy. Hassan said Tinubu secured victory largely through his own political strength, arguing that Buhari did not actively stand behind the APC candidate during the build-up to the election. He made the remarks on Tuesday during an interview on Channels Television’s Politics Today , while discussing the president’s chances of securing re-election in 2027. During the interview, Hassan was asked whether Tinubu would benefit from the organic political structure and support base associated with his predecessor, particularly as the APC prepares for another presidential contest in the next two months. In response, the APC stalwart questioned whether Buhari had given Tinubu the full backing of his political structure in 2023. “Did he enjoy that in 2023? Did we enjoy Buhari’s support in 2023? Let the truth be told, we did not,” he said. ﻿ When asked whether he was suggesting that Tinubu won the 2023 election on his own, Hassan answered in the affirmative, maintaining that the former president did not fully support his successor’s ambition. “On his own. Buhari didn’t fully come out to support Tinubu,” he said. He further argued that Buhari did not actively campaign for Tinubu during the 2023 election, despite both politicians belonging to the same political party. “Buhari didn’t do well in 2023. He didn’t actually come out to stand for us and stand for Asiwaju in 2023. Asiwaju won that election against all odds,” Hassan said. nigeria.description: A former National Commissioner of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), Festus Okoye, says the commission, the police and other law enforcement agencies can initiate an investigation into the ₦10 million pledge by the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, to councillors ahead of the 2027 general elections. Okoye, a lawyer, said this on Tuesday while appearing as a guest on Channels Television’s Politics Today. He said the absence of action by INEC would not prevent individuals or other relevant authorities from raising concerns or investigating the matter if an electoral offence was suspected. “If INEC is not taking this up, can anyone petition on this matter to say, I think Minister Wike is doing the wrong thing? nigeria.title: Obi counters Tinubu, defends Anambra erosion record
nigeria.description: Peter Obi, presidential candidate of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), has disputed President Bola Tinubu’s criticism of his record on erosion control in Anambra State, insisting that he helped develop the programme currently being used to tackle the environmental challenge. Tinubu had criticised Obi’s tenure as Anambra governor during an All Progressives Congress (APC) rally in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, over the weekend, alleging that the former governor “ran away from erosion” while highlighting environmental projects undertaken in Lagos. However, speaking on Tuesday during an interview on Rhythm FM Jos ahead of the NDC town hall meeting in Plateau State, Obi dismissed the allegation as untrue. The former Anambra governor said he worked with a former Minister of Environment to develop the erosion-control programme, which he said was subsequently adopted following his intervention with the late President Umaru Musa Yar’Adua. “On what the president said while campaigning in Akwa Ibom, it’s not true. I, working with the former minister of environment, developed what they’re using today to fight erosion,” Obi said. “I went to President Yar’Adua, made a suggestion to him. He called the minister and said he should go and develop it.” Obi governed Anambra State from 2006 to 2014, during which the state faced significant erosion challenges. At the Uyo rally, Tinubu had questioned Obi’s preparedness for the presidency, citing the erosion problem in Anambra as an example of what he described as shortcomings in his record as governor. Explaining his visit to Plateau State, Obi said it was part of his approach to engaging citizens and understanding their challenges before embarking on campaign rallies. He argued that political candidates should first listen to the concerns and experiences of the people before explaining how they intend to address them. The NDC candidate also identified insecurity in central Nigeria as a major challenge, stressing the need to ensure that residents could return to their communities, pursue their businesses and engage in farming without fear. He said his administration, if elected, would prioritise public services, particularly education and healthcare, as well as insurance coverage for vulnerable Nigerians. “Unless children go to school without fear, unless parents go to farms without fear, we don’t have a country,” he said. “You cannot stay in a developing country and a developing world if you have poor health accessibility and poor education accessibility. Education and health are the foundation for development. I will invest in them.” The post Obi counters Tinubu, defends Anambra erosion record appeared first on Vanguard News .

nigeria.description: Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde, has presented a proposed budget of ₦1.115 trillion for the 2027 fiscal year to the State House of Assembly for consideration and approval. Tagged the “Budget of Sustained Progress”, the proposal is valued at ₦1,115,341,378,359.90. Presenting the budget on Tuesday at the Assembly complex in Agodi, Ibadan, Makinde said it was designed to consolidate the gains of his administration and lay a foundation for sustainable development beyond its tenure. He described it as the final budget proposal of his administration, saying it would sustain the state’s development momentum and ensure continuity after the transition to a new government. “As we prepare to hand over the baton to the next administration, we bring before you the 2027 Budget of Sustained Progress. Extends free screening to staff, trade fair visitors By Olasunkanmi Akoni The Lagos State Government has urged residents across the state to embrace HIV testing as part of routine healthcare rather than wait until they suspect an infection before seeking screening. Meanwhile, the state government has extended free HIV testing and counselling services to public servants and visitors to the ongoing 2026 International Trade Fair as part of efforts to promote early diagnosis and expand access to HIV prevention and treatment. nigeria.title: Why an Instagram Following Tracker Can Reveal More Than a Profile’s Follower Count
nigeria.description: A popular Instagram account can attract thousands of followers, but that number rarely tells the whole story. For businesses, content creators, and people researching social media trends, another question can be just as interesting: which accounts does that person choose to follow? Someone may publicly promote fashion, technology, or entertainment while following creators in entirely different fields. A business account may begin following emerging influencers long before announcing a collaboration. A public figure may gradually change the types of accounts appearing on their Following list. These observations can provide useful context, particularly when viewed over time. An Instagram following tracker helps organize changes to the accounts a public Instagram profile follows. Rather than relying on a single snapshot, tools such as Snoopreport record detected follows and unfollows across reporting periods. The results can support social media research, although they cannot explain why someone followed an account or reveal information that Instagram keeps private. Why Follower Counts Don’t Tell the Whole Story Follower numbers are among Instagram’s most visible statistics. They influence how people assess popularity, reach, and sometimes commercial value. Yet having a large audience doesn’t necessarily mean an account has a clearly defined set of interests or strong connections within a particular industry. The Following list offers a different perspective. Consider a technology commentator who starts following several artificial intelligence researchers, software companies, and digital policy organizations. Those additions may suggest topics worth investigating. Similarly, a lifestyle influencer who follows numerous local restaurants might be exploring a new content category. Neither example proves a professional plan or future collaboration. Following someone can reflect curiosity, personal connections, or temporary interest. Still, when researchers compare several observations across time, they may discover changes worth examining further. The Difference Between Following and Followers Before using an Instagram following tracker, it’s important to distinguish two commonly confused terms. Followers are people who subscribe to an account’s updates. Following refers to the accounts that the profile has chosen to follow. For example, a creator may have 40,000 followers while following only 600 accounts. A following tracker focuses on changes within those 600 connections, not on identifying people who recently followed the creator. Instagram allows users to inspect the Following list of an accessible public profile. However, the list doesn’t provide a dependable chronological history of when each connection was added. The order in which accounts appear should not be treated as a reliable record of recent follows. To understand changes, the list needs to be observed across different periods. business.title: LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds
business.description: Bitcoin Magazine LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds LNbits, the open-source Lightning Network wallet and accounts platform, released version 1.7.0 on November 10 as an urgent security update and instructed all operators to upgrade before restarting their servers. The project’s official X account posted the announcement with a link to the GitHub release , calling it a “SECURITY UPDATE”. The release follows a wave of attacks that began over the weekend. On November 8, LNbits posted on X that all users should stop their LNbits servers immediately after reporting active attacks, adding that security patches were being prepared and that it was “better to err on the side of caution.” The project also disabled instances on its hosted service. Multiple reports documented unauthorized account creation and fund withdrawals. Kevin Ravensberg , operator of the Telegram tipping service BitTipBot, publicly stated that attackers created new accounts on his instance and withdrew 2,285,545 satoshis (approximately 0.0229 BTC) between roughly 09:22 and 14:00 UTC on November 8. According to the official upgrade guidance published alongside the release, versions prior to 1.7.0 are affected and “funds running on prior versions of LNbits are at risk of being stolen.” The project stated that 1.7.0 includes security fixes in response to the incident discovered on November 8 and that a full technical report on the exploit will follow. Operators are advised to set up a fresh server if compromise is suspected, because updating alone cannot remove access an attacker may already have gained. Additional recovery steps include rotating all user wallet keys as Super Admin, replacing funding-source credentials (API keys or macaroons), rotating other secrets stored in settings, and reviewing or re-creating connections for extensions such as NWC Provider, LNDHub, Bolt Cards, TPOS, Bleskomat, and FOSSA. The GitHub release notes describe extensive security hardening across authentication, extension management, and payment handling, plus dependency updates. New features shipping with the version include on-chain wallet support, BOLT12 offer payments, TOTP two-factor authentication, NIP-17 support, a job scheduler, automatic extension updates, and hold invoice support for the LNbits funding source. The project notes that LNbits functions as a hot wallet and that operators should keep only operational balances online, regularly review activity, and move excess funds to offline keys. LNbits was founded as a free and open-source project in 2019 by Ben Arc and later incorporated a commercial entity to support development. It provides multi-user accounts and a large suite of extensions on top of any Lightning funding source (including LND and Core Lightning). business.title: Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin
business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin A Texas lawmaker filed a bill Monday that would let each city and county in the state invest up to $10 million of public money in bitcoin or another cryptocurrency, without setting any rules for how those coins would be held. House Bill 815, filed by Rep. Ron Reynolds, a Missouri City Democrat, on the first day of prefiling for the 90th Texas Legislature, carries the caption “Relating to the authority of a municipality or county to invest money in cryptocurrencies.” The introduced text , posted on the Texas Legislature’s site, is two sections long. The bill would amend the Public Funds Investment Act, Chapter 2256 of the Texas Government Code, by adding a new Section 2256.0165, titled “Authorized Investments: Cryptocurrency.” Under that section, “a municipality or county may invest not more than $10 million of its money or money under its control in Bitcoin or another cryptocurrency.” The authority would take effect Sept. 1, 2027, if the bill becomes law. The $10 million figure is a cap on each city or county, not a single statewide pool. School districts and other local governments covered by the investment act are left out. What the bill does and does not say The measure borrows its definitions of “Bitcoin” and “cryptocurrency” from Section 403.701 of the Government Code, the definitions written into law last year by Senate Bill 21, which created the Texas Strategic Bitcoin Reserve . Bitcoin is defined as a decentralized cryptocurrency created by a peer-to-peer network that operates independently of any central authority or bank. Cryptocurrency is defined more broadly as a virtual currency that uses cryptography to secure transactions recorded on a distributed ledger, such as a blockchain. That means a city or county would not be limited to bitcoin. The bill also does not import the reserve law’s requirement that coins bought for the state fund have an average market capitalization of at least $500 billion over the most recent 24-month period, or its provisions on cold storage and qualified custodians. The Public Funds Investment Act already requires local governments to adopt a written investment policy that emphasizes safety of principal and liquidity, and to invest with the care a prudent person would use in managing their own affairs. A city or county would still have to add cryptocurrency to that policy before buying any. The new section itself is silent on custody, on audits specific to digital assets, and on how a loss would be handled. A narrower version of last year’s proposal Reynolds filed a broader measure, House Bill 4258, on March 10, 2025, with Rep. Mihaela Plesa. That bill would have let the comptroller invest as much as $250 million of the Economic Stabilization Fund, the state’s rainy day fund, in bitcoin or another cryptocurrency, and it included the same $10 million cap for cities and counties. business.title: Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review
business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review Poland’s lower house of parliament voted 240-202 on Friday to let the interior minister freeze crypto assets, bank accounts and other property of people placed on a national sanctions list, before any court reviews the order. The Sejm, Poland’s lower house, passed the Act on Restrictive Measures at its 68th sitting, with one member abstaining and 17 not voting. The Senate received the bill Monday and has 30 days under Article 121 of the Constitution to adopt, amend or reject it, after which it would go to President Karol Nawrocki. The law, a government bill that also implements European Union sanctions rules, treats crypto assets as financial means that can be frozen, using the definition in the EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation. A freeze, as the text defines it, is meant to stop any movement, transfer, use or other change that would let the holder benefit from the assets. The freeze applies only to people and entities the interior minister adds to a public national list, either on the minister’s own initiative or at the request of agencies that include the financial watchdog, the central bank, the financial intelligence unit and the internal security service. Grounds include supporting a country already under EU sanctions, serious human rights abuses, or initiating or financing information manipulation that poses a serious threat to Poland’s national security. A listing on that last ground requires a showing of a real and serious threat to Poland’s interests, borders, security or elections. The bill carves out ordinary journalism, political speech and publishing, unless that activity is a knowing campaign of the kind the law describes. A freeze that starts before a judge weighs in The interior minister’s decision takes effect the day after it is posted in the ministry’s Public Information Bulletin and is immediately enforceable. There is no request to the minister to reconsider. A listed person may file a complaint with an administrative court, but the law says the decision remains in force until a judgment becomes final, and it sets aside the usual rule that would let a court pause a challenged order. The measures also bar making funds or property available to listed persons and can exclude them from public contracts. In some cases, the economy minister may appoint a temporary administrator to sell frozen assets or, under a separate order, take them over for the State Treasury. What the freeze would mean for bitcoin The Poland bill does not target ordinary bitcoin holders in Poland. It reaches crypto assets owned, held or under the control of people and firms on the sanctions list. Through its City of Cities: Where Taste Rules experience, the brand transformed its eleven-year partnership with the fashion showcase into a celebration of the people, ideas, and experiences shaping the city’s creative identity, bringing fashion, music, innovation, and social connections together across the week. From runway presentations to the Heineken Lounge, the debut of Heineken Studio, and an energetic after-party, the brand created experiences that went beyond the collections on display, inviting guests to explore new expressions of taste, discover creative possibilities, and connect over shared interests. At the heart of the experience was City of Cities: Where Taste Rules, an experience inspired by the many influences that make Lagos what it is. First introduced in 2025, the concept recognises that Lagos is more than one city; it is a melting pot of different cultures, communities, sounds, and styles. At Lagos Fashion Week 2026, Heineken brought this idea into focus, celebrating the diversity of expression that makes the city’s creative scene distinct. The experience also marked another chapter in Heineken’s eleven-year journey with Lagos Fashion Week. Over the years, the partnership has explored the intersection of fashion, craftsmanship, and taste through initiatives such as Woven Threads in 2022, the Dyelab collaboration in 2023, and the H45 Collection in 2024, before introducing City of Cities: Where Taste Rules in 2025. Each edition has created a new way to engage with fashion and culture, with this year’s experience building on that foundation through fresh expressions of creativity and innovation. Across the venue, guests arrived in style, adding their own interpretations of fashion and self-expression to the atmosphere. The Heineken Lounge provided a space to unwind, exchange ideas, and connect as guests enjoyed chilled Heineken, refreshments, and the runway presentations. The experience also offered a taste of something different, with guests exploring Foam Infusions in exciting variations, including espresso and blood orange. A major highlight was the Nigerian debut of Heineken Studio, the brand’s Playground of Innovation, which brought together taste, creativity, and personal expression in an interactive space. Beyond discovering new ways to experience lager through Foam Infusions, guests could step into the painting studio to create personalised designs on their own Heineken cans. entertainment.title: 5 New Albums to Listen to This Week: Skepta, Phyno, Ty Bello & More
entertainment.description: Skepta holding the official clear vinyl edition of his sixth studio album, The Fork and Knife. Photo Credit: Skepta/Instagram Your playlist could do with a little shake-up, and these five albums might be exactly what it needs. Skepta is reconnecting with his roots, Phyno is giving us more of the indigenous rap we love, Ty Bello has two albums exploring different expressions of worship, and Anendlessocean and Tobe Nwigwe are taking their sounds in interesting directions. From UK grime and Nigerian hip-hop to alternative gospel and soul, there’s a lot to discover across these new releases. Whether you’re in the mood for bars, worship, thoughtful songwriting or music that brings different cultures together, this week’s selection has something worth hearing. Skepta: The Fork & Knife Back in 2012, Skepta found himself at odds with a corporatised grime scene, sparking a pivotal career reckoning that eventually led to his landmark 2016 album Konnichiwa. On his long-awaited 15-track sixth album, The Fork & Knife, the 44-year-old MC reflects on his journey as grime’s most influential elder statesman and the son of Nigerian immigrants. Named after his mother’s favourite proverb, the record is a deep exploration of identity and perseverance. Musically, Skepta bridges continents by blending global diasporic sounds. He teams up with Aya Nakamura on the zouk-infused “ Chippie ”, taps Asake for the Afrobeats crossover “ Aloe Vera ”, and recruits Chase & Status alongside Suggs for the sharp single “ Innocent Smile ”. The project closes with “ Belly ”, an eight-minute masterclass featuring Boy Better Know members Jme and Frisco . ﻿ Phyno: Let That Sink In Arriving nearly 10 years after his groundbreaking sophomore record The Playmaker, Phyno’s 15-track sixth solo album, Let That Sink In (LTSI), showcases his timeless command of indigenous rap. Across the record,the Enugu-born star blends soul, R&B, and traditional Nigerian sounds to explore faith, resilience, and personal evolution. The album features powerhouse collaborations, including Seyi Vibez on the opener “ Ndu Ka Aku ”, Fireboy DML on “ I Believe ”, and Jeriq on “ Ije Enu ”. Whether taking the government to task on “20 Years to Come” or offering uplifting anthems like “ Chukwu Okike ”, Phyno proves why he remains a definitive voice in African hip-hop. ﻿ Ty Bello: I Speak Lion and I Speak Lamb Creative powerhouse Ty Bello delivers a massive double-album listening experience with I Speak Lion and I Speak Lamb . Split into two distinct spiritual volumes, the expansive project captures both the bold, triumphant authority of worship and its quiet, intimate moments. ﻿ I Speak Lion leans into explosive, high-energy sounds designed to spark courage, featuring powerful pairings with Sunmisola Agbebi , Greatman Takit , and Limoblaze . In contrast, I Speak Lamb steps into soaking acoustic textures and tender devotional spaces, offering a complete, multi-layered sanctuary for listeners. ﻿ Anendlessocean: Freedom Alte

entertainment.title: Ifeyinwa Azubike Reconsiders the Rules of Dressing with The Ladymaker’s Stand On Ceremony
entertainment.description: During Lagos Fashion Week, The Ladymaker ’s Founder and Creative Director, Ifeyinwa Azubike, introduced Stand On Ceremony, a collection that considers the relationship between personal expression and the expectations attached to an occasion. Presented on 27 October 2026 at The Sphere, Lagos, the collection draws from the familiar expression to stand on ceremony: to insist on the observance of formalities. For Ifeyinwa Azubike, the idea presents an opportunity to examine the traditions women inherit, the rituals they observe and the choices they make when dressing for themselves. The collection is built around two identities: The Devotee and The Rebel. They are not opposing personalities so much as two ways of relating to ceremony. The Devotee embraces its rituals. She understands the language of formal dressing and participates in it with intention. For her, dressing fully is an expression of desire and personal conviction. The Rebel is equally familiar with the rules, but she is selective about the ones she follows. Her approach to dressing allows for disruption, though never simply for the sake of attention. Through these characters, Azubike considers a familiar experience for women: the pull between what an occasion expects and what an individual wants to express. Every woman who has dressed for an occasion has encountered this tension in some form, whether in choosing to honour a tradition or finding room to express herself within it. The garments give form to this conversation. The Cloister Dress is paired with the Banner Dress, while the Manor Jumpsuit is placed alongside the Assembly Set. Other looks, including the Herald Dress, Emissary Set, Procession Dress and Sovereign Set, extend the collection’s exploration of the two identities. Material choices move between crimson jacquard, rose jacquard, ice jacquard, denim Akwete, wine Adire, midnight sequins and beaded velvet. The collection draws on fabrics and textures that allow ceremony to be interpreted through different moods, silhouettes and degrees of formality. Stand On Ceremony was presented during Lagos Fashion Week through an intimate fashion presentation, followed by a soirée where guests could experience the garments more closely. The evening was held in partnership with MAC Cosmetics, which provided beauty; Moët & Chandon, the champagne partner; Jacque Scents, which created the fragrance experience; and The Nail Boutique , responsible for nail artistry. For Ifeyinwa Azubike, the question the collection leaves with its audience is a personal one: are you a Rebel or a Devotee? The Ladymaker Brand Profile Founded in 2015 by Ifeyinwa Azubike, The Ladymaker is a Lagos-based womenswear brand that brings together African heritage, classical elegance and contemporary design. Established by Azubike following a career in commercial law, the brand was born from a desire to create timeless clothing rooted in craftsmanship, fit and enduring style rather than fleeting trends. entertainment.description: Africa’s tech icon and Chairman of Zinox Group , Leo Stan Ekeh , has told an international gathering of women leaders that his decision to build a technology company in Africa, at a time when the sector was virtually non-existent on the continent, amounted to what he described as “corporate suicide”. Speaking on the theme “Losing the Fear” , at The International Women Leadership Conference (TIWLC) in Dubai, organised by the Ibukun Awosika Leadership Foundation, Ekeh , who was a keynote speaker on the final day of this year’s conference, addressed over 600 women industry leaders from different countries across the globe. He said he returned from his studies abroad to a Nigeria where his peers were filing into banking, oil and gas, and where technology was largely seen as a foreign game. Ekeh, who studied Economics in India, said he was discouraged from pursuing a postgraduate degree in Computer Science in Europe because of the prevailing perception then that Africa might have little need for computers over the next 35 years, potentially leaving him frustrated. He subsequently opted for a postgraduate degree in Risk Management before pursuing a Master’s degree in Business Law (LLM) at London Guildhall University. He recalled that he could not sit his final law examinations because he had diverted his tuition fees into his passion for technology entrepreneurship. He also disclosed that he had fended off recruitment attempts by international technology companies that had sought to hire him before his return to Africa. “I chose the road not taken,” he told the conference. “It was corporate suicide in the eyes of my parents and many others. I lost the fear because I believed technology was the master key that would unlock possibilities for Nigeria and Africa.” He said the journey came with considerable hardship, including living on one meal a day for over three years and sleeping in a very small room in his office. According to him, his vision was to create a Nigerian and, by extension, an African IT identity. Recalling the launch of his first company, Task Systems Ltd, over 35 years ago, the company that pioneered desktop publishing and computer graphics in Nigeria. At the launch, held at the Sheraton Hotel, Ikeja, Ekeh recalled addressing an overcrowded hall filled with industry leaders, some of whom were seeing computers for the first time. He told them: “No country can claim to be independent without technology independence.” He said the Nigerian media embraced the vision, describing him as a “miracle child” and supporting the company’s roadmap. This, he noted, contributed to the computerisation of over 97 per cent of media and multimedia houses in Nigeria, as well as in other African countries. entertainment.title: Midea Introduces Space Master Refrigerator in Nigeria, Bringing More Room to Everyday Living
entertainment.description: Midea is introducing the Space Master Refrigerator to Nigerian consumers, placing practical food storage at the centre of its “More Room for Nigeria” campaign. The introduction speaks to a familiar household situation: a major grocery shop, a weekend of hosting or a family celebration can quickly turn refrigerator space into a daily planning challenge. Space Master is presented with a simple proposition: “Same Size. More Space. More Capacity.” Its approach to storage design gives households more usable interior space for the food, drinks and everyday essentials they need to keep at home. For households planning meals ahead, the practical question is not only what to buy, but where everything will go. Fresh produce, bottled drinks, ingredients for family meals and food prepared for guests all compete for space. Space Master’s bigger-capacity proposition gives consumers more room to accommodate larger grocery shops, everyday essentials and food for family occasions, helping households prepare more comfortably for both daily routines and celebrations. “ More Room for Nigeria” connects that functional product story to everyday Nigerian life. From stocking up for a busy working week to preparing for a family gathering, the campaign shows why usable storage matters at moments when households need flexibility. Its companion message, “Every Celebration Needs More Room,” gives the product a role in the preparations for the occasion — before guests arrive, meals are served and memories are made. The campaign also places product discovery at the heart of the consumer experience. Through planned retail demonstrations, shoppers will be invited to open the Space Master, explore its interior layout and see examples of how groceries and meal-preparation items can be arranged. The “Grocery Fit Challenge” and household grocery scenarios are designed to make the storage proposition tangible, while store representatives can answer model-specific questions and explain the purchase process. Midea ’s approach reflects a focus on applying product design and practical technology to everyday consumer needs. By making storage easier to visualize and explore, the brand aims to help shoppers evaluate how a refrigerator can suit their routines, household size and entertaining needs. Consumers interested in Space Master can enquire at authorized Midea retail outlets and request an in-store demonstration and confirmation of the specific model’s specifications, current stock availability and applicable purchase terms before making a decision. entertainment.title: Nkanyeziyethu Malunga: The Zimbabwean Designer Preserving African Heritage Through Fashion
entertainment.description: At her workshop in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe, Nkanyeziyethu Malunga crafted colour into fabric, using plants, tree bark and other natural materials gathered from the environment. Choosing a colour or designing a pattern is only one of the processes. Each material carries details on how it was gathered, prepared, and transformed, which Malunga is incorporating into contemporary fashion. “My dyes are mainly extracted from plants such as mnyii and hibiscus. Although I also use many other plants, including tubers, that have properties suitable for dye extraction. I love hibiscus not only for its petals, which produce beautiful dyes, but also for its tea.” The 37-year-old designer is challenging conventional notions about what defines a fashion collection and where creative knowledge originates. Through her clothing business, GANU, she transforms indigenous materials and skills into clothes and accessories, demonstrating how knowledge passed down through generations can inform modern design, provide opportunities for rural women, and conserve cultural practices. Her method is based on teachings learned from her late maternal grandmother, Ngatsha Nkatha, who resided in Tsholotsho, a rural district in Zimbabwe. During the school vacations, Malunga and her siblings traveled from Bulawayo to visit grandma, witnessing as she turned sisal, sedge, and reeds into winnowing baskets. “When I was a child, I often visited my grandmother in the village with my siblings. She was very dexterous with her fingers, and that passion eventually became mutual.” Malunga started experimenting with fashion in her teens before launching Ganu in 2013. The name is derived from iganu, the Ndebele term for marula fruit, and represents her connection to local resources and African identity. Her creations blend basketry, crocheting, batik, and beadwork with natural dyes, leather, and other locally produced materials. For Malunga, the importance of these materials goes beyond their appearance. Bamboo, sisal, reeds, and sedge are used in basketry, and she breeds Angora goats for their fur, which she straightens and dyes to make garments. Cowhide obtained from local abattoirs is softened in a tannery before being mixed into leather designs. “I keep Angora goats for the fur needed in garment production. However, for raw materials such as cowhide, I usually source these from local abattoirs while sisal and tree barks are either harvested by me or sometimes extracted by colleagues I work with, who are based in the rural areas.” Desmond Ntini , a cultural entrepreneur based in Bulawayo, sees Malunga’s work as part of a broader shift in how African history is perceived and used. ” Malunga is redefining the fashion industry by blending traditional African influences with contemporary creativity. entertainment.title: History in Morocco! How Nigeria’s Flamingos Won the World Cup
entertainment.description: The Flamingos celebrate on stage with green and white confetti as they lift the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup trophy. History was made in Rabat as the Flamingos of Nigeria conquered global football at the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup. Under head coach Akeem Busari , the team executed an extraordinary seven-match campaign at the finals, overcoming an early setback to claim six consecutive victories and become the first African nation to lift any FIFA women’s international trophy. Midfielder Oluebube Umejiaku earned individual recognition by winning the FIFA Golden Ball as the Player of the Tournament alongside Player of the Match honors in the final. The squad also displayed exceptional attacking breadth, scoring goals through eight different players across seven matches at the finals while registering over 100 goal attempts. Oluebube Umejiaku poses with the FIFA Golden Ball and Player of the Match awards following Nigeria’s World Cup triumph. Here is the match-by-match breakdown of how Nigeria navigated the African qualifiers, powered through the World Cup group stage, defeated multi-time global champions in the knockouts, and clinched the ultimate trophy in Morocco. Nigeria’s Flamingos celebrate becoming the first African nation to win the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup after defeating Japan 2-1 in Rabat. Phase 1: The African Qualifying Journey Nigeria entered the African U-17 World Cup qualifying campaign in the second round, establishing dominance in home-and-away aggregate ties across West Africa. The Flamingos opened their qualification run with an emphatic 5–0 away victory in Guinea, led by team captain Harmony Chidi ’s first-half hat-trick alongside goals from Oluwakemi Adegbuyi and Mary Dunstan . They followed up with a 7–0 victory in the home leg in Ogun State to complete a 12–0 aggregate shutout. The Flamingos celebrate on the pitch following their matchday four fixture at the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup. In the final qualifying round, Nigeria established a three-goal lead in Monrovia by defeating Liberia 4–1, thanks to a brace from Harmony Chidi and goals from Shakirat Moshood and Peace Effiong . Chidi then sealed a 2–0 second-leg win back home to finish the qualifiers with 12 goals and secure Nigeria’s ticket to Morocco. Phase 2: Group B at the World Cup (Morocco) Placed in Group B alongside Poland, Puerto Rico, and defending world champions DPR Korea, Nigeria had to battle through one of the tournament’s most competitive pools. The campaign started with a tight 2–1 loss to Poland in Rabat, putting pressure on the team to perform in their remaining fixtures. The Flamingos bounced back immediately with a 2–0 shutout victory over Puerto Rico to claim their first three points. sports.description: New York Yankees designated hitter Giancarlo Stanton Giancarlo Stanton missed most of the New York Yankees' season this year, and there was speculation that the team could finally move on from him this winter. When healthy, Stanton is an impact bat with tons of power. However, he has not been healthy too often. He is 37 years old, and the Yankees owe him $15 million for next season. He has a $15 million club option with a $10 million buyout for 2028. Despite rumors of the Yankees potentially moving on, general manager Brian Cashman made it clear that Stanton is not going anywhere. "There's never been a time when he's healthy that he's not been impactful," Cashman said on Tuesday . "If he's healthy, I know he can impact. sports.title: Oregon star edge rusher Teitum Tuioti out for the season
sports.description: EUGENE — One of Oregon football’s most important defensive players is done for the season. Ducks senior defensive end Teitum Tuioti suffered a season-ending knee injury in Oregon’s 41-28 win over Ohio State , Dan Lanning announced on Monday. “Teitum has been unbelievable for us this year, and every year he’s been here,” Lanning said. “Just watching him grow as a player and person has been a lot of fun for us. sports.title: Damian Lillard is back and Ja Morant is here. How exactly is this going to work? | Bill Oram
sports.description: In the history of basketball, we have certainly seen some why-would-they-do-that? pairings. Jerseys and sleeves. Kawhi Leonard and a tree sponsorship. Utah and “the Jazz.” Once, there was even Detlef Schrempf and a headband, if you can believe that. Ja Morant and Damian Lillard? We’re about to find out if they belong on such a list. Because of all the things you might have said the Trail Blazers needed as they prepared to welcome Lillard back after making a playoff run without him, a slight-of-stature ball-dominant guard with a questionable jump shot would not have topped anyone’s list. Depth on the wing? Yes. Shooting? Definitely. Defense? Always. Morant doesn’t particularly address any of those, and yet, he’s here, a dynamic two-time All-Star in need of a second act, being paid a team-high $42.1 million to play the same position as not just Lillard, but Jrue Holiday and Scoot Henderson. Heck, the Blazers’ most valuable point guard last season was forward Deni Avdija. “I’m sure there will be questions about fit,” General Manager Joe Cronin said Monday. Uh, yeah. The Blazers have little more than three weeks before the regular season begins in which to figure that out. At the team’s annual media day on Monday, Morant appeared in a fresh white No. 1 Trail Blazers jersey. It’s happening. “It’s easy for people to be like, ‘Man how is this going to work,’” Lillard offered. “‘They can’t do this, they can’t do that.’ But being on the floor with them … we can be a dangerous team and I really believe that.” The onus is on the Trail Blazers starting this month to prove that they bet right in acquiring Morant. And that pairing him with Lillard isn’t the boondoggle conventional wisdom suggests it will be. Lillard noted how many teams that succeeded in the playoffs last year, think San Antonio with its four point guards, relied on numerous playmakers. To his credit, Morant said he would be comfortable coming off the bench, if necessary. sports.title: Who will call plays for Oregon after Mehringer's firing?
sports.description: EUGENE — After firing first-year offensive coordinator Drew Mehringer seven games into the 2026 season, Dan Lanning shared Oregon ’s plans for filling his role moving forward at his weekly press conference Monday night. Feyi-Waboso has scored nine tries in 17 appearances for England since making his Test debut against Italy in 2024. However, his progress with England has been checked by a string of injuries. He returned this summer, scoring in wins over Fiji and Argentina, but suffered an autumn-ending ankle injury in the first half of Sunday's match against Australia. Robinson, whose acceleration and side-step brought him 28 tries in 51 appearances for England between 2001 and 2007, tore his hamstring in the Rugby World Cup final defeat by South Africa in his final Test. sports.title: Kirk Cousins has 3-word message for Fernando Mendoza after Raiders trade
sports.description: Fernandomania has officially begun in the desert. With the Las Vegas Raiders trading quarterback Kirk Cousins to the Minnesota Vikings in before Tuesday’s NFL trade deadline, Las Vegas are expected to turn to Fernando Mendoza , the No. 1 pick in the draft earlier this year, under center. Mendoza is slated to make his first career start against the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks at home on Sunday, Nov. 15 (4:05 ET). Mendoza’s lone regular-season action came during his debut, at the end of a Week 4 road loss to the New England Patriots on Oct. 11. He finished 6-for-8 passing for 48 yards. Mendoza’s first two opponents boast vaunted defensive units. Seattle’s defense, dubbed the “Dark Side” for a reason, did not allow a touchdown last week to the undermanned Arizona Cardinals. Looking ahead, the Raiders face the Denver Broncos on the road in Week 11. Denver ranks in the top 10 in points allowed per game (20.7), sacks (26) and takeaways (12). "I feel that Fernando has done a great job,” Cousins told reporters Oct. 26. “He has a bright future ahead. I'm going to try and go out there and play as well as I possibly can and try and win and give him a good example to learn from." On his Instagram story, Cousins offered a goodbye to “Raider Nation” and a message to Mendoza, whom Cousins tagged in the post. “Go get em (sic),” Cousins wrote. Toughening matters for Mendoza on the field will be the lack of a rushing attack for the Raiders. First-round talent Ashton Jeanty from the 2025 draft has not worked out, although rookie Mike Washington has shown some juice in the backfield. Still, Las Vegas ranks 31st in rushing yards per game (71.3) and is last in yards per rush (2.9). Similar to Cousins, Mendoza will likely have to shoulder much of the output in the Raiders’ offense. “The game has to be balanced,” head coach Klint Kubiak said following the team’s most recent loss to the San Francisco 49ers that dropped their record to 4-5. “You can’t be a running and throwing team when you're throwing it every time. That's not easy. “You got to start the game a lot faster. You got to go toe-to-toe in the first half so that the second half isn't a throwing fest.” The good news is that tight end Brock Bowers ranks ninth in the league in receiving yards and provides a crucial red-zone target with six touchdowns already this season. Wide receiver Tre Tucker emerged as a reliable downfield option for Cousins, which gives Mendoza more relief in the passing game. sports.title: AFC Team Shows Interest in Ex-Steelers Kicker
sports.description: Pittsburgh Steelers kicker Ben Sauls in a preseason game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Aug. 16, 2025. -- Ed Thompson / Steelers Now A former kicker of the Pittsburgh Steelers could soon have a new home in the NFL. The Miami Dolphins worked out former Pittsburgh Steelers kicker Ben Sauls on Tuesday, according to NFL insider Aaron Wilson of Houston’s KPRC2 . #Dolphins worked out Marcus Banks, Daniel Carlson, Cameron Dorner, Kahlef Hailassie, Chris Hilton, Austin Reed, Ben Sauls, Christopher Smith, Bailey Zappe — Aaron Wilson (@AaronWilson_NFL) November 10, 2026 Sauls, 25, was just released by the New York Giants in September and has been looking for his next opportunity since. Sauls played his collegiate career at the University of Pittsburgh and signed with the Steelers as an undrafted free agent out of the 2025 NFL Draft. He impressed during the preseason, making five of his six field goal attempts and going seven of seven on extra points. “Really happy for Ben Sauls. The work he was able to show us,” head coach Mike Tomlin said. “Good for him.” Pittsburgh Steelers kicker Ben Sauls during a preseason game against the Carolina Panthers on Aug. 21, 2025. — Ed Thompson / Steelers Now However, Sauls’ future in Pittsburgh was always uncertain since the team already had two-time Pro Bowl kicker Chris Boswell on the roster. The Steelers did try to trade Sauls following his standout preseason performance, but they were unable to find a trade partner and waived him ahead of the cutdown day deadline. On Sept. 23, 2025, the Atlanta Falcons signed Sauls to their practice squad. He was then released on Nov. 4 and the Giants signed him one week later. Sauls’ time with the Steelers was brief, but he was still very appreciative of Pittsburgh’s veterans for showing him the ropes at the next level. “To have guys who have been there and done that for years. I mean, the age gap. I think the second youngest is 30, maybe 31. I just turned 24 a couple of weeks ago. I am a breath of fresh air for these guys. But they’ve been there, they’ve done that,” Sauls said. “They reassure me on the field. And to have them with me this whole way. That’s why we just got a silly picture of us. Because I really appreciate what they’ve done for me. And they really took me in and showed me the ropes.” In 2024, Sauls connected on 21 of 24 field goals and a perfect 44 of 44 on extra points at Pitt. He was selected to the Pro Football Focus All-American team and a Lou Groza Collegiate Place-Kicker Award Semifinalist. Overall, Sauls finished his college career hitting on 52 of 64 field-goal attempts, while averaging 63 yards per kickoff. sports.title: Luiten Backs McIlroy’s Plan To Cut PGA Tour Cards
sports.description: Brett Davis-Imagn Images Rory McIlroy wants to slash the number of European players who earn PGA Tour cards, and Joost Luiten agrees with the move. The Dutch veteran told GolfMagic that limiting the spots is actually good for the DP World Tour. Limiting the spots could stop the drain of top talent moving across the Atlantic before their prime. Luiten believes the current system of ten cards is too generous and hurts the European circuit. He told GolfMagic, “It means there will be less cards next year, and I think three or four cards will be a good number so that we don’t lose all of our top players.” McIlroy made similar comments last week at the Abu Dhabi Championship. “I thought five was a nice number,” McIlroy said. “I think it would probably be a little less than that. I’d say it’ll probably be four. If I know what I’m talking about, which I usually do!” The Alliance Clock Is Ticking The strategic alliance between the two tours runs until the end of 2027, forcing a new deal before 2028 changes take hold. Luiten noted the urgency of this timeline in his interview with GolfMagic. “All I know about the alliance is that 2027 is the last year and we need to come to a new agreement for 2028,” Luiten added. “It will be very interesting to see how that deal is going to look.” The current setup lets the top ten in the Race to Dubai earn cards if they do not already hold membership. That path might disappear or shrink significantly under the new structure. McIlroy thinks the PGA Tour was leaning toward three spots while the European Tour wanted five. He predicts they will meet in the middle at four. This reduction means fewer Europeans get a direct shot at the biggest purses in the world. It forces players to stay and fight on home soil rather than taking a lateral move to the Challenger Series. Luiten sees this as a necessary step to keep the tour competitive. Keeping Talent in Europe The fear is that top players will leave if the pathway becomes too hard or too easy. Too many cards mean Europe loses its stars. Too few might kill the dream for rising prospects. Luiten argues that three or four is the sweet spot. It keeps the pressure high but ensures the best remain visible on the DP World Tour. McIlroy’s influence as a six-time major winner gives his weight to this argument. The upcoming DP World Tour Championship in Dubai will test the current standings before the new rules arrive. Eugenio Chacarra leads the Race to Dubai, but McIlroy is close behind. The winner on Sunday earns a crucial 2,000-point bump according to Yahoo Sports . With 1,335 points awarded for second and 752 for third, the payouts are set. How Chacarra performs will determine if McIlroy secures his eighth Race to Dubai title, catching Montgomerie. Until 2027 concludes, the strategic alliance stands, necessitating a fresh deal before 2028 changes occur.
